subject: Audit log archive delivery timeline and format clarifications
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audit log archive delivery timeline and format clarifications

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for including Redwood in the Evergreen Health RFP. As we prepare the response package, the audit committee asked for a concrete delivery timeline and a technical spec for the audit-log handoff so they can validate ingestion and chain-of-custody procedures on their side.

High level asks from Evergreen:
- A date-by-date schedule for final archive delivery (manifest + compressed bundles)
- Exact artifact formats (event schema, compression, checksums)
- Transport options (S3 presigned + cross-account, signed HTTPS endpoint, or physical media)
- Tamper-evidence and retention metadata (how you demonstrate files were not modified post-delivery)
- Contact for receiving and verifying manifests at Evergreen (security/procurement)

We have a short spec draft attached (Redwood-Audit-Export-Spec-v1.pdf) that describes our standard exports. If you can confirm the preferred transport and target window (they've asked for delivery within 30–45 days of contract signature), we will map the milestones in the formal MPO/Mutual Action Plan.

Also copying Marissa for legal/invoice sequencing and Karthik for technical validation.

Thanks —
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Compliance Solutions | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Audit log archive delivery timeline and format clarifications

Naomi —

Appreciate the spec. A few quick notes from Evergreen security & procurement:
1) Delivery window: procurement prefers us to receive the first full archive within 30 days of executed MSA, with a follow-up delta export (if applicable) within 7 days after that.
2) Transport preference: our default is cross-account S3 (aws-account-id provided later) with manifest + checksums. We can accept HTTPS pulls for small bundles but would like S3 for bulk.
3) Tamper evidence: we need MD5 or SHA256 checksums for each bundle in the manifest and an overall signed manifest (PGP or equivalent).
4) Retention: Evergreen will confirm required retention length (likely 7 years for clinical audit trails). Please confirm Redwood's long-term retention snapshot capability and whether we can request ad-hoc extracts after retention period for legal holds.

Two quick technical questions for Karthik:
- Do your export bundles include event-level timestamps in UTC and monotonic sequence IDs?
- Can we request filtering by tenant_id + org_id for scoped exports (we'd prefer not to receive multi-tenant dumps)?

If you can respond to those points we'll add the delivery milestone to our procurement worksheet and loop in legal for the MSA redlines.

--Michael
Michael Parker
Security Program Manager | Evergreen Health
mparker@evergreenhealth.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Michael Parker <mparker@evergreenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Apr 2026 08:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit log archive delivery timeline and format clarifications

Michael —

Thanks, answering inline below and attaching two examples (s3-manifest-sample.csv and chain-of-custody-template.docx) to make verification easier.

Delivery window
- We can commit to initial full export within 30 days of MSA execution for the baseline archive. For ongoing delivery we support a 7-day delta cadence or on-demand snapshots for legal hold.

Transport
- Cross-account S3 is supported. We will provide presigned Put roles and a delivery manifest that includes the bucket/key prefixes. HTTPS pull is supported for <10 GB bundles.

Tamper evidence
- Each bundle is gzipped (gzip -9) and accompanied by MD5 and SHA256 checksums recorded in the CSV manifest. We also publish an overall manifest.json that includes a manifest-level signature via our KMS-backed signing process (detached signature). If Evergreen requires PGP, we can produce an additional PGP-signed manifest.

Retention and ad-hoc extracts
- Redwood keeps operational logs for 90 days on hot storage by default, with tiered cold snapshots retained as long as the customer contract specifies. For Evergreen we can enable 7-year cold retention as a contractual option. Ad-hoc extracts after retention expiration can be supported via our preservation program (legal hold-triggered snapshot) but will require prior notice and an extract fee for cold-retrieval.

Event schema and filtering
- Exports are newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) with the following canonical fields: event_id, tenant_id, org_id, service, level, ts_utc (ISO8601), seq_no, payload (string). We include seq_no for monotonic ordering within each tenant stream. Per-tenant scoped exports are supported — we will not include cross-tenant data if you request tenant_id scoped delivery.

S3 manifest example (attached)
- The attached s3-manifest-sample.csv contains columns: object_key, gz_size_bytes, md5_hex, sha256_hex, first_event_ts, last_event_ts, tenant_id. We will also include a top-level manifest.json with per-bundle metadata and the detached signature.

Chain-of-custody
- The attached chain-of-custody-template documents the steps we record on transfer: generation time, hash calculations, delivery role ARN, presigned URL expiry, and receipt acknowledgement step for Evergreen to confirm checksums. We can complete that template and sign it as part of the delivery handoff.

Next steps
1) Confirm: Evergreen preferred AWS account id for cross-account delivery + desired bucket prefix.
2) Confirm: whether PGP-signed manifests are required or our KMS-signed manifests are sufficient.
3) Once confirmed, we will draft a delivery schedule (dates/timestamps) and include it in the MPO.

Happy to hop on a 30-minute handoff call if that helps — propose Mon or Tue next week.

Thanks,
Naomi

Attachments: s3-manifest-sample.csv (CSV, 2 KB); chain-of-custody-template.docx (DOCX, 48 KB)

Please go ahead and draft the MPO with initial delivery 30 days after MSA execution and a 7-day delta export cadence. Also include the cold-retention option for 7 years as an add-on line item in the quote. We will schedule a 30-minute call on Tue 20 Apr 10:00 PT to walk through the manifest verification, if that slot works for Redwood.

I'll also send a receipt checklist to security@evergreenhealth.com for the internal verifier.

Thanks —
Michael
